name: aws_ecr_repository
description: Provides an ECR (Elastic Container Registry) repository resource. ECR is a managed Docker container image registry that is integrated with ECS, EKS, and IAM. It supports image lifecycle policies, image scanning, and encryption.
use_cases: Store Docker images for ECS or EKS deployments
Automated vulnerability scanning of container images
Private container registry with IAM-based access control
Multi-account image sharing via resource-based policies

required.name: name
required.description: Name of the repository. Repository names can contain letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and forward slashes.

optional.name: image_tag_mutability
optional.description: 'MUTABLE' or 'IMMUTABLE'. Use IMMUTABLE in production to prevent tag overwriting. Defaults to MUTABLE.

optional.name: force_delete
optional.description: If true, allows deleting the repository even if it contains images. Default: false. Dangerous for production.

optional.name: image_scanning_configuration
optional.description: Configuration block for image scanning. Enable scan_on_push to automatically scan images.

optional.name: encryption_configuration
optional.description: Encryption configuration. Use KMS for customer-managed encryption. Default: AES256.

optional.name: tags
optional.description: Map of tags to assign to the repository.

best_practices: Use IMMUTABLE image tags in production to ensure deployment reproducibility
Enable image scanning on push to detect vulnerabilities automatically
Implement lifecycle policies to control storage costs
Use KMS encryption for compliance requirements
Pin image versions with digests (sha256:...) in ECS/EKS task definitions
Use separate ECR repositories per environment (dev/staging/prod)
Set up ECR replication for multi-region disaster recovery
security_notes: Enable scan_on_push and review scan results before deploying to production
Use resource-based policies to restrict cross-account access
Never use 'latest' tag in production — use immutable semantic versions
Implement ECR repository policies to prevent public access
Regularly review and rotate ECR access credentials for CI/CD systems

common_errors.error: Access denied when pushing to ECR
common_errors.fix: Run 'aws ecr get-login-password | docker login' first. Verify IAM user/role has ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability permissions
Either set force_delete = true (dangerous) or delete all images first using aws ecr list-images and batch-delete-image
